text: The Program Manager, Music, Economic Development and Culture, will give a presentation on the status of ongoing work on music-related initiatives, such as: - Creative Co-location Facilities Tax Subclass - 2022 uptake/timelines; - Music rehearsal space - report recommendations; - Amplified Music on Patios; - Licensing and Zoning Review for Restaurants, Bars and Entertainment Venues - timeline and process; - Juno Awards; and - MusiCounts - Music Office collaboration.
The Toronto Music Advisory Committee received the item for information.
